description:
Compare one listing's asking price with comparable homes on Cubi.

    Returns the range of ASKING prices of comparable active listings in the
    same city (25th-75th percentile, with the number of comparables) and
    where this listing's own asking price sits against it: below, within or
    above. This is a comparison of asking prices, not a valuation and not a
    prediction of the sale price — say so when you relay it. When too few
    comparables exist, no range is returned; do not invent one.

    Args:
        listing_id: Source-prefixed listing id from a prior search result
            (e.g. `remax:12345`). Do not invent one.
        lang: ISO 639-1 language code (en/pt/es/fr/de/nl/ru). Defaults to en.

    Returns:
        JSON with asking_price, band {low, median, high}, n_comps,
        asking_vs_band, and links to continue on Cubi — or a not-found
        message.
name: compare_asking_prices
title: Compare asking prices
